chain_words.nuance: to have a small effect that may not be serious
to cause a negative effect, often on people or health
to cause physical or lasting harm to something
to cause very severe destruction over a wide area
to damage something so badly that it no longer exists

explanation: These words all describe a negative effect on the environment, ranging from a small effect to complete destruction.

usage_notes.difference: 'Harm' often describes effects on living things or health, while 'damage' often describes physical objects or land, although both can be used for either.
